sentences.en: To cause laughter without joining in greatly heightens the effect.
sentences.zh: 不参与却能引发笑声，会让效果更好。

sentences.en: The risk of fire is heightened in low-energy houses.
sentences.zh: 在低能耗房屋中，火灾的风险会更高。

sentences.en: She tried to allay their fears but only ended up heightening them.
sentences.zh: 她试图安抚他们的恐惧，但反而让恐惧加剧了。

senses.zh: 提高；加强；增高；使更显著 -
